title: Docker registry sign-in config
whyItMatters: Saved registry auth entries in this file can let someone pull or push container images as the account owner.
notes: On macOS Docker Desktop normally uses the OS keychain as credential helper. The config file is never opened by vacate.

cleanup.signOut: Sign out of Docker Desktop and of each registry listed in the file, so the saved logins stop working.
steps: Open the file named in the plan and note which registries have saved logins.
Sign out of those registries and of the Docker account.
Delete the file named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
Remove any Docker entries from Keychain Access.
cleanup.risk: Pulling or pushing private images needs a new sign-in; registry addresses saved in the file are lost.
